# Pull request

## Summary

<!-- What changed and why? Link the related issue with "Fixes #123" when applicable. -->

## Type of change

- [ ] New or updated YAML source (`server/services/`)
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Refactor (no behavior change)
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Build / packaging

## Checklist

- [ ] `cargo check --workspace` passes (from `server/`)
- [ ] `npm run type-check` and `npm run build` pass (from `front/`) — if the frontend is touched
- [ ] Documentation updated when behavior changed (`README.md`, `docs/`, crate READMEs)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` entry added under `Unreleased` (append-only)
- [ ] Code, identifiers, comments, and commit messages in English
- [ ] No personal data, credentials, or third-party copyrighted material included
